title: Pair Correlation of Zeros of the Riemann Zeta Function I: Proportions of Simple Zeros and Critical Zeros
publication_status: arXiv preprint; v3 is latest per arXiv. Latest comment reports June 10, 2026 submission and review in progress.
full_text_access: Complete v1, v2, and v3 primary arXiv PDF files and extracted text archived.
audit_scope: Complete v3 reading, pp. 1–16, with targeted v1 and v2 correction and theorem comparisons. The earlier 2024 journal text is access-restricted. External cited proofs were outside scope.
selection_reason: Primary author correction to PAPER-A006's published Theorem 1 form-factor remainder, together with stronger joint simple-and-critical zero results under a dyadic thin-box assumption.
